rec.name: PDP Highlighted Discount Code Block (Copy-to-Clipboard)
rec.status: Built — launched (simple clipboard version; auto-apply version planned as a separate ticket)

what.text: A card in the product-info area that highlights a discount code. It shows a headline such as "-20% with the code", a copy-to-clipboard button labelled with the code (e.g. ESN), and a short body text (e.g. an additional quantity discount and a hint to redeem the code in the cart). It also shows the calculated discounted price in an accent color next to the struck-through original price, and an optional "Learn more" link.

why.text: Showing the price after the code turns an abstract coupon into a concrete saving. The strikethrough original price adds price anchoring and a visible reference point. One-click copy removes the friction of remembering or typing the code, which reduces coupon-hunting drop-off. Putting the offer on the PDP, before add-to-cart, raises perceived value at the decision point. The quantity-discount hint nudges a larger basket (AOV).

how.text: Build it as a theme block inside the main product section so it can be positioned freely among the other product-info blocks. Three steps: (1) add the block schema (type highlight_discount) to the blocks of the product section schema; (2) create the snippet highlight-discount.liquid, which renders the card, the CSS, and a small JS clipboard handler; (3) add a `{% when 'highlight_discount' %}` case to the product form's block-type switch that renders the snippet. The discounted price is calculated in Liquid as the selected_or_first_available_variant price minus the configured discount percentage. The block renders only if a discount code is entered. The user clicks the button, the code is copied with navigator.clipboard, and a tooltip ("Code copied!") shows for 3 seconds. The shopper then pastes the code in the cart or checkout voucher field. For a product-specific code, link the discount code field to a product metafield, so the block appears only on products that have a value. Note that the code is not applied automatically.

items: Device display: desktop only / mobile only / both
Discount code (text; blank = block hidden; can be bound to a product metafield for product-specific codes)
Body text (richtext, e.g. quantity discount or redeem hint)
Learn more link text (blank = link hidden)

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with a product section that supports blocks (main-product.liquid and product-form.liquid in the reference theme; file names vary by theme). The discount code must already exist in Shopify admin. Optional product metafield for product-specific codes. The percentage entered must match the real discount in Shopify, since the displayed price is only calculated, not read from the discount. Code is not applied automatically; an auto-apply variant would need cart/drawer integration and was split into a separate ticket. Positioning (above/below/next to the product) is handled by block order in the theme editor. The original ticket also requested options not in the delivered code: scheduling, customer-segment targeting, collection targeting, multilingual input, and a separate quantity-discount toggle. Installation docs were still being clarified for non-expert users.

items: AOV and units per order (quantity-discount hint)
